command:
set -eu
echo FW_RESOLVER_START
cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id
cat /proc/uptime
echo FW_RESOLVER_ROOTS
for p in /factory_peq/tcon_data/QD /opt/media/USBDriveA/TCON /opt/media/USBDriveA1/TCON /opt/media/USBDriveA2/TCON /opt/media/USBDriveA3/TCON /opt/media/USBDriveA4/TCON /opt/media/USBDriveB/TCON /opt/media/USBDriveB1/TCON /opt/media/USBDriveB2/TCON /opt/media/USBDriveB3/TCON /opt/media/USBDriveB4/TCON /opt/media/USBDriveC/TCON /opt/media/USBDriveC1/TCON /opt/media/USBDriveC2/TCON /opt/media/USBDriveC3/TCON /opt/media/USBDriveC4/TCON /opt/media/USBDriveD/TCON /opt/media/USBDriveD1/TCON /opt/media/USBDriveD2/TCON /opt/media/USBDriveD3/TCON /opt/media/USBDriveD4/TCON; do
 if test -d "$p"; then
  echo "PRESENT $p"
  stat -c '%n %F' "$p"
  readlink -f "$p"
  find "$p" -maxdepth 4 -print
 else
  echo "ABSENT_OR_NOT_DIRECTORY $p"
 fi
done | awk 'NR<=100 {print substr($0,1,256)} length($0)>256 {long++} END {print "ROWS",NR; print "LONG_PATHS",long+0}'
echo FW_RESOLVER_END
cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id
cat /proc/uptime
mode: read-only candidate path metadata, not updater invocation
